run_create_data_for_online_st: run the CLI to create data for online self-training with dataset and input CSV paths
initialize_cache: initialize a ListCache for language pairs by loading paired PyTorch dataset files and saving pickle caches
get_tensors: convert reloaded dataset positions and sentences into padded PyTorch LongTensor sequences with length tensors
add_self_trained_dataset: apply BPE encoding to Java functions from a DataFrame, split into GPU-partitioned files, and preprocess with XLM
output_multilingual_tests_dataset: merge Python and CPP translated test DataFrames into a JSON file with mutation scores and assert counts
review_Params: review the Params class that configures pad index, eos index, tokens per batch, and self-training removal probability
